title: Bano maqtal me kehti ye aayi aa meri godi aa mere
body:
Bano maqtal me kehti ye aayi aa meri godi aa mere asghar
tere soorat ke sadqe ho daayi aa meri godi aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jhoola qaali hai kisko jhulaau lori dekar kise mai sulaau
Tumne jungle me basti basaai aa meri godi aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
qaako khoon me pade aa uthaalu mujh se roothe ho tum ko manaalu
Kaise sote pade ho mai aayi aa meri godi aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
tumne jungle me basti basaai humne ro ro qayamat machaai
ab tumhe milne maqtal me aayi aa meri godi aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
basti waalo ne milkar dagha ki yaa'n ke haakim ne humpar jafa ki
Doongi jaakar najaf me dohaai aa meri godi aa mere asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jhandoole tere baal pyaare qaako khoo'n me aalooda saare
koi mannat badhaane na paayi aa meri godi aa mere asghar
